params.body:
`/internal/taxonomy` also returns the needs (`drivers`, `driver_label`), taken from the Standard via `needs.mjs`.

The site builds all its labels from this endpoint, never from a hand-written list (see `Taxonomy.php`). Without this, a trend's need would show on the site as a bare id (`driver-autonomy`).

Builds on #223 (`needs.mjs`); merge after it.

Checks: 951 tests, 0 failures.
params.title: The taxonomy the site reads carries the needs
